menu_viewmodelrecoil_recoil_enabled_desc: If true, moves the viewmodel instead of the camera during weapon recoil.
menu_viewmodelrecoil_steelsightrecoil_en: If true, allows moving the camera during weapon recoil (uses default PD2 behavior)
menu_viewmodelrecoil_staticrecoil_enable: Prevents camera re-centering after muzzle climb. Only applicable to camera-based recoil.
